info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Human Resource Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Employee Evaluation Management API provides functionality to retrieve evaluation records for employees based on specified criteria. This endpoint allows businesses to access detailed evaluation information, which can assist in performance reviews and talent management initiatives. Users such as HR professionals and managers can leverage this API to gather insights into employee performance and make informed decisions about training, promotions, or development. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their talent management processes and improve workplace effectiveness.

get.description: Fetch the details of an employee evaluation based on the provided employee ID. This endpoint allows users to obtain evaluation reports, performance metrics, and any other relevant information associated with the specified employee.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the evaluation details for a specific employee identified by the unique employee ID 'EMP-900045'. You must include the necessary authentication and permissions to access this resource.

200.description: Successful retrieval of employee evaluation data.

GetHumanResourceManagementByParam1Reques.description: This schema represents a JSON string that contains employee evaluation data for the specific request identified by EMP-900045.
